candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (~2s ReadTimeout), causing order to return 502 and gateway /v1/checkout to fail with 502 at ~2s; payment p95 latency is ~4875ms while it still returns 200.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment returns 200 on some requests, so the timeout is intermittent; the internal cause of payment slowness is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show order->payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory/redis succeed; order returns 502 and gateway checkout returns 502 at ~2s. Payment p95 latency ~4875ms supports downstream-latency as the bounded cause. Order deployment record (v1.0.0, no previous version) does not establish deployment causation.
